source_text: Among Nairobi truck drivers in Kenya, uncircumcised men exhibited significantly higher HIV seroprevalence (13% versus 3% in circumcised men), with prospective follow-up confirming elevated incidence linked to uncircumcised status after adjusting for confounders like sexual behavior.
